rule: Fixed application-resource downloads only; no data-upload exceptions. Do not auto-rebaseline.

web/index.html.review: External anchor is a fixed, user-activated link to source code with noopener and no-referrer. Release builder substitutes only a validated GitHub repository slug and build SHA. The local licence is served with static resources. No prefetch, automatic navigation, user data or identifying metadata is sent. Presentation only: Verification evidence and review controls are reparented into sibling panels and the Import Review action is visually prioritised. Static no-referrer source links are unchanged. Startup source review: the new opening screen renders fixed text and the existing same-origin mark. The build versions that mark together with the favicon. No project information reaches a resource address.

web/assets/analysis-worker.js.review: Reviewed fetch/importScripts load only the same-origin pinned Python runtime, fixed manifest and fixed Python module paths. Input bytes are written to browser-local Pyodide FS; results use worker postMessage.

web/assets/app.js.review: Legacy unused source downloads Python runtime and fixed engine files only and uses local blob exports. It is not referenced by the deployed index.

web/assets/fastpath-worker.js.review: Reviewed importScripts resolves the fixed fastpath-core.js asset with release token; parsing and results remain within browser workers.

web/assets/simulation-results.js.review: Simulation inspection constructs one fixed same-origin worker URL with a validated static build token. Local File handles and mapping fields travel by worker messages. Imported text is confined to textContent and option labels. The workspace has no storage or upload path.

web/assets/simulation-results-worker.js.review: The worker loads one fixed versioned parser script. It reads local File slices, retains bounded in-memory typed results and returns samples through worker messages. Map keys and source metadata do not affect any resource address or headers.

web/assets/project-home.js.review: ICM toolkit links use fixed resource basenames, a validated semantic toolkit version generated by the static builder and the existing release token. Requests require a user's download action. No project data enters filenames, URLs, headers or storage. Ruby files are downloaded as local scripts and are never executed by the web app.

web/assets/network-schematic-loader.js.review: Reviewed lazy script URLs are the three fixed same-origin schematic assets plus the fixed release token; no source or calculation metadata is included.

Explicit local Blob download destinations and all fixed-resource requests remain unchanged. Numeric values/calculations are unchanged; formula-leading untrusted strings receive a text prefix. Regression tests cover control/whitespace prefixes, quote escaping and negative numbers. The owner authorised single-maintainer release subject to mandatory checks and effective branch protections; no independent human approval is claimed. 2026-10-18 source review: the global esc alias is replaced with an explicit local five-character HTML escaping function with byte-equivalent output, preserving quoted attributes and SVG text. All resource URLs, local exports, geometry and calculation paths are unchanged. Hostile names/comments/scenarios are tested through canvas, SVG and local HTML export. SVG camera offsets use Number at the rendering-only coordinate boundary; valid numeric coordinates are unchanged. The local encoder uses one regex callback matching the original global encoder. This fixes an actual malformed-gap injection surface; no hydraulic equation, calculation input, network destination, handler or export destination changes. Browser tests include the malformed gap as well as hostile text fields; release remains blocked pending final scan/browser evidence. Core geometry, imported numeric validation, hydraulic inputs and outputs are unchanged; existing label/connector unit and browser export coverage remains mandatory. UI review: evidence inspector docks outside the canvas and reads current browser-local monitor and review state. Rendered values use the existing escaping helper. ICM reference compatibility raises the size limit for the existing local file selection; network and persistence paths are unchanged. Clear map confirms through a fixed local dialog, invalidates any pending schematic file read, checkpoints the in-memory schematic for session Undo, and persists the empty schematic through the existing localStorage and workspace snapshot path. No source files are removed, no engineering method or request changed, and no new storage key, resource address, or data destination is added. v2.1 explorer review: navigational gestures and minimap only change local camera coordinates or SVG presentation. Imported values and editable properties render with DOM text APIs. The inspector invokes the existing local file input; saved attributes and references use the same local workspace/schematic key and export functions. Asset attributes, local file workflows, browser storage, workers, fixed resource addresses and report export paths are unchanged.
